scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Uh... who are you?
Sorry, I'm not good at remembering people's faces! But I think you are not good enough to ask about my work here.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
呃...你是誰？
抱歉，我不太擅長記人臉！不過我覺得你還沒資格打聽我的工作。

scripts.text: - This is a quest that can be performed at level 200 or higher -
scripts.translation: - 這是一個200級或以上才能進行的任務 -

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Oh, {0}. Are you here for a drink?
I just had a business, and it went well.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
哦，{0}。你是來喝酒的嗎？
我剛談完一筆生意，進展得很順利。

scripts.text: What is it for?
scripts.translation: 這是為了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
You know that Secret Wing and our rebellion have been tracking the traces of Illusion's illegal experiments, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
你知道秘密翼和我們的反叛者一直在追蹤<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺非法實驗的痕跡，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
In the meantime, I found a way to the 4th floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
在此期間，我找到了通往魯杜斯第四層的路。

scripts.text: Well, I know.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我知道了。

scripts.text: Where was Rudus?
scripts.translation: 魯杜斯在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Hehe, it's good to have a good conversation with {0}.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
呵呵，能和{0}好好聊天真好。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
What, how many times did you forget?
It was the place where Illusion abandoned the failed works that were created after the experiment.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
什麼，你忘了多少次了？
那是<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺在實驗後遺棄失敗品的地方。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Remember Morning? Where the little boy stays.
He is on the first floor, and Rudus itself exists on the second and third floors.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
記得晨星嗎？就是那個小男孩住的地方。
他在第一層，而魯杜斯本身存在於第二層和第三層。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
By the way, the 4th floor of Rudus is quite amazing...
Somehow, among the test subjects abandoned in Rudus, only particularly strong ones seem to be gathered.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
順便說一下，魯杜斯的第四層相當驚人...
不知為何，被遺棄在魯杜斯的實驗體中，似乎只有特別強的那些聚集在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Researchers of the Secret Wing say that after fierce competition among the subjects, the strongest subjects seem to have settled there.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
秘密翼的研究員說，在實驗體之間經過激烈的競爭後，最強的實驗體似乎定居在那裡了。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Well, actually, I'm not sure how complicated it is!
It seems that the Secret Wing researchers need to study the entities there.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
嗯，其實我也不確定情況有多複雜！
看起來秘密翼的研究員需要研究那裡的實體。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
So I was looking for someone to help me.
To be precise you, {0}!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
所以我在找人來幫我。
準確地說，就是你，{0}！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Do you need a job? I know everything~
If you have an idea, go to the 3rd floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
你需要工作嗎？我什麼都知道~
如果你有個想法，就去魯杜斯的第三層吧。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
<NAVI>[Pion]<INFO>sp_rudus3,380,42,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is in control of the path leading down to the fourth floor.
Go and tell him I sent you, and find out if it's worth it to come!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
<NAVI>[皮翁]<INFO>sp_rudus3,380,42,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 控制著通往第四層的通道。
去告訴他是我派你來的，看看是否值得去！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Do you need a job? I know everything~
If you have an idea, go to the 3rd floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
你需要工作嗎？我什麼都知道~
如果你有個想法，就去魯杜斯的第三層吧。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
<NAVI>[Pion]<INFO>sp_rudus3,380,42,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is in control of the path leading down to the fourth floor.
Go and tell him I sent you, and find out if it's worth it to come!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
<NAVI>[皮翁]<INFO>sp_rudus3,380,42,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 控制著通往第四層的通道。
去告訴他是我派你來的，看看是否值得去！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Oh, you went down to the 4th floor of Rudus. How was it?
Is Pian doing well? Did the subjects feel a bit worthy of a fight?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
哦，你去了魯杜斯的第四層。感覺如何？
皮翁還好嗎？實驗體們感覺有點值得一戰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Then help me study the people from the Secret Wing.
I was looking for someone to hunt them, because I was not enough to catch and research monsters myself.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
那麼幫我研究一下秘密翼的人吧。
我一直在找人獵殺他們，因為我自己不夠強，無法捕捉和研究魔物。

scripts.text: Ask if I can just hunt
scripts.translation: 問是否可以只進行獵殺

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Oh, I almost forgot.
If you attach this chip somewhere on your body and hunt them, researchers can receive data.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
哎呀，差點忘了。
如果你把這個晶片貼在身上某個部位去獵殺它們，研究員們就能接收到資料。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
New material, eco-friendly, non-toxic, safe material, so you don't have to worry about it.
Where would you like to hang it?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
這是新材料，環保、無毒、安全，所以你不用擔心。
你想把它貼在哪裡？

scripts.text: Earlobe
scripts.translation: 耳垂

scripts.text: Back neck
scripts.translation: 後頸

scripts.text: Back of hand
scripts.translation: 手背

scripts.text: Forehead
scripts.translation: 額頭

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Okay, I'll attach it well so it doesn't bother you.
Okay, that's it then...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
好的，我會貼好，確保不會讓你感到不適。
好了，就這樣...

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Please take good care of me today!
So, what kind of research would you like to help with today?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
今天請多多關照！
那麼，今天你想協助進行哪種研究？

scripts.text: Abyssal Solitude
scripts.translation: 深淵孤寂

scripts.text: Transformation and Evolution
scripts.translation: 轉化與進化

scripts.text: Data Backup
scripts.translation: 資料備份

scripts.text: Don't help
scripts.translation: 不協助

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Secret Wing researchers are resting.
So, {0}, how about coming back after a little rest?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
秘密翼的研究員們正在休息。
所以，{0}，不如稍作休息後再回來？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
The 4th floor of Rudus is not a comfortable place to go in and out easily.
Let's get some rest and work fully prepared!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
魯杜斯的第四層並不是一個可以隨意進出的舒適之地。
讓我們休息一下，做好充分準備再行動吧！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
A place where only strong individuals survive and bite weaker ones...
Like a deep, dark pit of solitude.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
一個只有強者才能生存，並狠咬弱者的地方...
就像深邃黑暗的孤寂深淵。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Well, I don't know about that!
My job is to deliver the requests of researchers.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
嗯，這個我不太清楚！
我的工作是傳達研究員們的請求。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Researchers want to know how the subjects of Rudus differ from those distributed on the 4th floor.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
研究員們想知道魯杜斯的實驗體與分佈在第四層的實驗體有何不同。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
How much more has it lost it's original form, and whether it has changed itself after the experiment.
<FONT SIZE = 9>Um... these researchers look a little dangerous too? I think that's how all researchers are, to a person like me.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
它們失去了多少原本形態，以及在實驗後是否發生了自我改變。
<FONT SIZE = 9>嗯...這些研究員看起來也有點危險？我覺得對我來說，所有研究員都是這樣的。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Anyway, you want to collect <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Dolorian, Plagarion, and Deadre</FONT> data.
What if we hunt 10 individuals each?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
總之，你想收集<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>多洛裡安、普拉格利安和迪德雷</FONT>的資料。
如果我們各獵殺10只，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I'll come hunting
scripts.translation: 我去獵殺

scripts.text: I refuse
scripts.translation: 我拒絕

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
We're already comrades on the same boat~?
Isn't that right, comrade? Think again!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
我們已經是同一條船上的同志了~？
對吧，同志？再想想吧！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Okay, if you go hunting and from hunting, data will be gathered.
And my allowance will be accumulating!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
好的，如果你去獵殺，就能收集到資料。
而且我的零花錢也會增加！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Secret Wing researchers want to collect <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Dolorian, Plagarion, and Deadre</FONT> data.
What if we hunt 10 individuals each?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
秘密翼的研究員們想要收集<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>多洛裡安、普拉格利安和迪德雷</FONT>的資料。
如果我們各獵殺10只，怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Today's hunting seems to be successful!
How did you know, {0}, the chip I put on you worked today.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
今天的獵殺似乎很成功！
{0}，你是怎麼知道的，我裝在你身上的晶片今天起作用了。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
I see it every time, but every time it's amazing, how the chip works.
Well, I should pay you for the work you did today.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
我每次都看到，但每次都很驚訝，晶片是怎麼工作的。
好了，我應該支付你今天的工錢。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Here you are!
Then since you've finished your work, take a good rest. Please take care of me tomorrow as well~
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
給你！
既然你完成了工作，就好好休息吧。明天也請多多關照~

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Secret Wing researchers left work already.
So, {0}, how about coming back after a little rest?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
秘密翼的研究員們已經下班了。
所以，{0}，你稍微休息一下再回來怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
The 4th floor of Rudus is not a comfortable place to go in and out easily.
You too, get a good rest, and let's work fully prepared!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
魯杜斯的第四層不是一個可以隨意進出的舒適地方。
你也好好休息，讓我們以充分的準備狀態工作！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
The 4th-floor entities Giant Caput and Venedi are greatly altered from the other-floor entities
to become gigantic, or to harbor more venom...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
第四層的實體巨首和維內迪與其他樓層的實體相比，發生了巨大的變化，
變得巨大，或者攜帶更多的毒液...

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Researchers seem to be very interested in these guys.
That's why I ask you to hunt them.
<FONT SIZE = 9>Um...why don't we do it? There must be something complicated at the upper level. I don't know.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
研究員們似乎對這些傢伙非常感興趣。
所以我請你去獵殺它們。
<FONT SIZE = 9>嗯...我們為什麼不做呢？上層一定有什麼複雜的事情。我不知道。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Can you hunt 15 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Giant Caput and Venedi</FONT> each?
Data will be collected automatically, so you just need to focus on hunting.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
你能各獵殺15只<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>巨首和維內迪</FONT>嗎？
資料會自動收集，所以你只需要專注於獵殺。

scripts.text: I'll hunt them
scripts.translation: 我去獵殺它們

scripts.text: I refuse
scripts.translation: 我拒絕

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
We're already comrades on the same boat~?
Isn't that right, comrade? Think again!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
我們已經是同一條船上的同志了~？
對吧，同志？再想想吧！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Okay, go and hunt hard!
My bonus depends on your performance!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
好的，去努力獵殺吧！
我的獎金取決於你的表現！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Can you hunt 15 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Giant Caput and Venedi</FONT> each?
Data will be collected automatically, so you just need to focus on hunting.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
你能各獵殺15只<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>巨首和維內迪</FONT>嗎？
資料會自動收集，所以你只需要專注於獵殺。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Have you been well? You came back from hunting safely.
Please tell me that the researchers worked hard today.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
你還好嗎？你安全地從獵殺中回來了。
請告訴我，研究員們今天工作很努力。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Looks like good data has been gathered.
Then I should pay you for the work you did today.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
看起來收集到了很好的資料。
那麼我應該支付你今天的工錢。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Here you are!
You worked hard today, so get a good rest and come back. Let's work hard tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
給你！
你今天工作很努力，所以好好休息，然後回來。讓我們明天繼續努力！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
The researcher said he's withdrawn now. Chip maintenance is enough once a day!
So, {0}, how about coming back after a little rest?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
研究員說他現在撤回了。晶片維護一天一次就夠了！
所以，{0}，你稍微休息一下再回來怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
The 4th floor of Rudus is not a comfortable place to go in and out easily.
Let's get some rest and work fully prepared!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
魯杜斯的第四層並不是一個可以隨意進出的舒適之地。
讓我們休息一下，做好充分準備再行動吧！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Oh, by the way, are the chips sticking well?
It doesn't last that long...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
哦，順便問一下，晶片粘得還好嗎？
它不會持續那麼久...

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
And I have to back up and format the data I have collected so that I can receive new data, but I don't have the talent to do that...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
而且我必須備份並格式化我收集的資料，以便接收新資料，但我沒有這方面的天賦...

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
I'll introduce you to a researcher who is currently in the field, would you like to go directly?
He is probably disguised to observe monsters, but I'll give you the location, so go check it out!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
我可以介紹一位正在外勤的研究員給你，你想直接去找他嗎？
他可能正在偽裝觀察魔物，但我可以告訴你他的位置，快去看看吧！

scripts.text: Look for him
scripts.translation: 去找他

scripts.text: Don't look for him
scripts.translation: 不找他了

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Isn't it frustrating to only work with me?
It wouldn't be a bad idea to meet the researchers working in the field...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
只和我一個人工作是不是很無聊？
去見見在外勤的研究員也不錯...

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Yeah! Isn't it frustrating to only meet with me to get work delivered?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
是啊！只和我一個人交接工作是不是很煩？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
I'm on my way to see him, so if you have any questions, you can ask him directly!
I heard that <NAVI>[Researcher]<INFO>sp_rudus4,192,204,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> mostly burrows around the center of the 4th floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
我正準備去找他，如果你有什麼問題，可以直接問他！
聽說<NAVI>[研究員]<INFO>sp_rudus4,192,204,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>大多躲在魯杜斯第四層的中央附近。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
I'm on my way to meet the Secret Wing researcher, so if you have any questions, you can ask him directly!
I heard that <NAVI>[Researcher]<INFO>sp_rudus4,192,204,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> mostly burrows around the center of the 4th floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
我正準備去見秘密翼研究員，如果你有什麼問題，可以直接問他！
聽說<NAVI>[研究員]<INFO>sp_rudus4,192,204,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>大多躲在魯杜斯第四層的中央附近。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Have you been there? Did you talk a bit?
Is the researcher hiding well?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
你去了嗎？聊得怎麼樣？
研究員藏得好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
He's known for hiding very well, even though he doesn't have the skills to hide.
That's why you're out in the field.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
他雖然不會隱匿技能，但據說藏得非常隱蔽。
所以你就在外面待命吧。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Because this is also a job... Since I safely replaced him, the superiors asked me to take care of the allowance.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
因為這也是工作的一部分...既然我安全地替換了他，上級就讓我負責發放津貼。

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Well, it's good that you came back to me too!
Then have a good day and see you tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
嗯，你回來找我也很好！
那麼祝你今天愉快，明天見！

scripts.text:
[Yulma]
Eh, won't you?
I was eagerly waiting for {0}!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾瑪]
誒，你不來嗎？
我一直在期待{0}呢！

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Zzz... Whoa!
Excuse me, sir! No more work!
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
呼...哇！
抱歉，先生！我不幹了！

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Seup, Ha-am... Down this slope is an access control area.
People are not allowed to enter.
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
呼...哈...這個斜坡下方是管制區域。
禁止人員進入。

scripts.text: I'm not an ordinary person.
scripts.translation: 我不是普通人

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Yes? Ah... ah no! {0} !
That... Still, I can't let you in on my own.
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
是...啊...啊不！{0}！
那個...但我不能擅自放你進去。

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Zzz... Whoa!
Excuse me! No more work!
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
呼...哇！
抱歉！我不幹了！

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Oops... ah, this is definitely not saliva
It is a drop of sweat that shines with passion and effort.
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
哎呀...啊，這絕對不是口水。
這是閃耀著熱情與努力的汗滴。

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Hmm, hmmm. The entrance down this slope is now restricted...
What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
嗯...嗯。這個斜坡下方的入口現在被封鎖了...
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: I want to go to the 4th floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation: 我想去魯杜斯第四層

scripts.text: Point out the working attitude.
scripts.translation: 指出工作態度

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Oh, there's a problem with your working attitude?
Sa, some people might sleep!!
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
哦，你的工作態度有問題？
喂，有些人可能會睡覺的！！

scripts.text:
[Pion]
I only slept a little!
Really!
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
我只睡了一小會兒！
真的！

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Fourth floor? I'm in control right there...
Ah, did you come to see Yulma from Bullet Meow?
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
四樓？我正好在這裡負責管理...
啊，你是來找子彈喵的尤爾瑪的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Then you should pass it.
If you want to look at the specimens on the 4th floor and help with a research request, go back to <NAVI>[Yulma]<INFO>pub_cat,94,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask.
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
那你應該直接通過。
如果你想檢視四樓的標本並協助研究請求，請回到 <NAVI>[尤爾瑪]<INFO>pub_cat,94,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 處詢問。

scripts.text:
[Pion]
I'll move you to the 4th floor.
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
我會把你傳送到四樓。

scripts.text:
[Pion]
Zzz... Huh! Shi, excuse me!
Are you sure you want to go down to the 4th floor of Rudus?
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
呼... 啊！什... 抱歉！
你確定要去魯杜斯四樓嗎？

scripts.text: Move
scripts.translation: 前往

scripts.text: Do not move
scripts.translation: 不要移動

scripts.text:
[Pion]
I see. Ha-am....
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
明白了。哈...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Pion]
I'll move you. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[皮翁]
我要傳送你了。請多關照！

scripts.text:
[Secret Wing Researcher]
Good. Field work.
You have to watch a lot of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[秘密翼研究員]
很好。實地工作。
你需要觀察很多魔物。

scripts.text:
[Secret Wing Researcher]
...huh!
How did you recognize me?
scripts.translation:
[秘密翼研究員]
...啊！
你怎麼認出我了？

scripts.text:
[Secret Wing Researcher]
Oh, look again, {0}.
I got a call. Are you here to renew the chip?
scripts.translation:
[秘密翼研究員]
哦，再看一眼，{0}。
我接到電話了。你是來更新晶片的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Secret Wing Researcher]
Let's see... Let's get some chips.
Hmmmm... Connect with my machine... Empty data...
scripts.translation:
[秘密翼研究員]
讓我看看... 我們來獲取一些晶片。
嗯... 與我的機器連線... 資料為空...

scripts.text:
[Secret Wing Researcher]
Okay, that's it! The data is clean and very nice. I'll paste it again.
scripts.translation:
[秘密翼研究員]
好了，就是這樣！資料很乾淨，非常好。我會再次貼上它。

scripts.text:
[Secret Wing Researcher]
Because this is also a job, <NAVI>[Yulma]<INFO>pub_cat,94,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> will give you a small allowance when you return.
I am always indebted to you. Good job!
scripts.translation:
[秘密翼研究員]
因為這也是一份工作，<NAVI>[尤爾瑪]<INFO>pub_cat,94,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 會在你回來時給你一點津貼。
我一直感激你。幹得好！

scripts.text:
[Secret Wing Researcher]
Evil! If you pretend to know, monsters will come!
Go away!
scripts.translation:
[秘密翼研究員]
邪惡！如果你假裝認識，魔物就會來的！
快走開！

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
I would like to do more research, but if my life is really in danger...
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
我想做更多的研究，但如果我的生命真的處於危險之中...

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
I have no choice but to hire a strong and sincere adventurer. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
我別無選擇，只能僱傭一位強大且真誠的冒險者。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
I think level 200 would be enough... It's easy to say, but that is not the type of person who can be easily found.
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
我覺得200級就足夠了... 說起來容易，但那種人並不容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
Oh, oh my, my gosh. The strong and sincere adventurer I've been looking for has appeared here.
Would you like to help me with my research?
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
哦，天哪，我的天。我一直在尋找的強大且真誠的冒險者出現了。
你願意幫助我的研究嗎？

scripts.text: Listen to the request
scripts.translation: 聽聽他的請求

scripts.text: Suspicious...
scripts.translation: 可疑...

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
Even if I look at you with my eyes I recognize your skills at a glance, please do something...!
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
雖然我一眼就能看出你的實力，但還是請你幫個忙...！

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
Even if I look at you with my eyes I recognize your skills at a glance, please do something...!
...?
What? Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
雖然我一眼就能看出你的實力，但還是請你幫個忙...！
...？
什麼？你願意幫我？

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
No, that's it... Everyone refused, so the hanging words got stuck in my mouth.
Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
不，就這樣吧...大家都拒絕了，所以這句話一直卡在喉嚨裡。
謝謝你的配合。

scripts.text: You're still cooperating...
scripts.translation: 你還是在配合...

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
Come on, that's it. Of course someone as talented as you can go to Niflheim.
Of course I don't have many days left and it's not the right time for me to go and I can't come back in time.
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
好了，就這樣吧。像你這樣有才華的人當然可以去尼弗爾海姆。
我時日無多，現在也不是我動身的時機，而且我也回不來了。

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
According to recent sources... Deep in the darkness of Niflheim, the dead hold a banquet,
in a form we cannot imagine.
But there is nowhere to hear more about it.
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
根據最近的訊息...在尼弗爾海姆深處的黑暗中，死者正在舉行宴會，
其形式是我們無法想像的。
但無處可聽更多詳情。

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
You'll find out soon anyway, but I'm curious now.
Can you take a look? I'll give you plenty of examples.
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
你很快就會知道的，但我現在很好奇。
你能去看一下嗎？我會給你足夠的報酬。

scripts.text: That's enough. Can I come back?
scripts.translation: 夠了。我能回來嗎？

scripts.text: What if I can't come back?
scripts.translation: 如果回不來怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Old scholar]
You wouldn't even think that you wouldn't be able to come back at your level...
If you're still that careful, okay. Come back when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[老學者]
以你的等級，你不會覺得回不來吧...
如果你還是這麼謹慎，好吧。等你準備好了再來。

scripts.text:
[Garim Springfield]
Thank you. Turns out I forgot to introduce myself.
My name is Garim Springfield.
I worked at Sage Castle for a long time... Now that I'm retired, I want to spend some leisure time here and also put in requests...
scripts.translation:
[加里姆·斯普林菲爾德]
謝謝。原來我忘了自我介紹。
我叫加里姆·斯普林菲爾德。
我在賢者城堡工作了很多年...現在退休了，想在這裡度過閒暇時光，順便釋出一些委託...

scripts.text:
[Garim Springfield]
Okay. It's worth it.
Grant an idle old man a wish.
Then I'll wait for the good news.
scripts.translation:
[加里姆·斯普林菲爾德]
好的。值得。
滿足一個閒散老人的願望。
那我就等著好訊息了。

scripts.text:
[Garim Springfield]
What are you doing? Go fast.
scripts.translation:
[加里姆·斯普林菲爾德]
你在幹什麼？快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Garim Springfield]
Huh? Did you really visit the banquet hall deep in Niflheim?
You came back alive?
Okay then, tell me your story.
scripts.translation:
[加里姆·斯普林菲爾德]
咦？你真的去了尼弗爾海姆深處的宴會廳？
你活著回來了？
好吧，告訴我你的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Garim Springfield]
Hmm hmm... I see!
I am prepared like this, so I won't be afraid if I go later!
scripts.translation:
[加里姆·斯普林菲爾德]
嗯嗯...我明白了！
既然我已經做好了準備，之後我去也不會害怕了！

scripts.text:
[Garim Springfield]
The research will last forever...!
scripts.translation:
[加里姆·斯普林菲爾德]
研究將永遠持續下去...！

scripts.text:
[Garim Springfield]
I felt like I could do research even after dying, so I felt better.
scripts.translation:
[加里姆·斯普林菲爾德]
我覺得即使死後也能繼續研究，所以感覺好多了。

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
Ha-am...
I can't sleep
What's the fuss that you can't sleep even after you're dead?
Let's get some sleep...
I'm going to die because of the noise.
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
哈啊...
我睡不著。
吵死了，都死了還睡不著，真夠煩人的。
讓我睡一會兒...
再吵下去我要被吵死了。

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
Ha-am...
Huh? What? I don't deal with peddlers.
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
哈啊...
咦？什麼？我不跟貨郎打交道。

scripts.text: You have a bad complexion
scripts.translation: 你的臉色很差

scripts.text: Go back quietly
scripts.translation: 安靜地離開

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
Oh, I did mean to ask you if you had sleeping pills... But I'm dead... You won't hear me... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
哦，我本來想問問你有沒有安眠藥...但我已經死了...你聽不見我說話...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
Uh, how did you know?
My complexion must look real bad...
Do you have a sleeping pill?
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
呃，你怎麼知道的？
我的臉色一定很糟糕...
你有安眠藥嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not a junkie
scripts.translation: 我不是癮君子

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
Ah... I'm sorry. I misunderstood. All the people who have come this far were weird kids or people who sold drugs, so I kicked them out.
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
啊...抱歉，我誤會了。之前走到這裡的人都是些奇怪的小孩或者賣毒品的，所以我把他們趕走了。

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
By the way... how did you know that I am tired? Does my complexion look that bad?
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
順便問一下...你怎麼看出我很疲憊的？我的臉色有那麼差嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
Actually, I've been dead for a while, but I've only recently come to Niflheim. So I decided to sleep here in this house...
I can't sleep at night because it's so noisy next door.
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
其實我死了一段時間了，但最近才來到尼弗爾海姆。所以我決定在這間房子裡睡覺...
因為隔壁太吵了，我晚上根本睡不著。

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
No, it's the pain of not being able to sleep because the next door is noisy even though I'm already dead..
Oh, not next door. They all ran away.
There's a reason why it is so cheap...
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
不，是因為隔壁太吵，導致我雖然已經死了卻睡不著的痛苦...
哦，不是隔壁。他們都跑光了。
這裡租金這麼便宜是有原因的...

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
Yes, <NAVI>[there]<INFO>niflheim,148,124,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>
The crazy villagers over there... they have a banquet every day.
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
是的，<NAVI>[那裡]<INFO>niflheim,148,124,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>
那邊的瘋狂村民們...他們每天都在舉辦宴會。

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
I'm in there every day, every day!!
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
我每天都得在那裡面，天天如此！！

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
Ha... I know, even if it's every day, there's a set time.
By the way... If you were a drinker, who would have gone home on time, while you were alive, would you do that even in death?
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
哈...我知道，即使是每天，也有固定的時間。
順便問一下...如果你生前是個酒鬼，按時回家，死後還會這樣做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
I'm... dead, so I just want to sleep peacefully...
I hope they return to their senses after the banquet is over.
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
我...已經死了，只想安靜地睡個覺...
希望宴會結束後他們能恢復理智。

scripts.text: Banquet is...
scripts.translation: 宴會是...

scripts.text:
[Tired looking dead]
Yeah... you look pretty strong and there's alcohol... they are dead, so it's magic.
If you can silence those who are drunk with magical powers all night long, I will reward you.
Yes, of course every day.
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的亡者]
是的...你看起來很強壯，而且那裡有酒...他們死了，所以那是魔法。
如果你能用魔法讓那些喝醉的人整晚保持安靜，我會獎勵你。
是的，當然，每天都要這樣。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
I am Milla. I am now a resident of Niflheim.
Please help me sleep, my dear.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
我是米拉。我現在是尼弗爾海姆的居民。
請幫我睡個好覺，親愛的。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
Yes, thank you for coming back.
Ha-am...
For me and my neighbors... for a good night's sleep.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
是的，謝謝你回來。
哈啊...
為了我和鄰居們...為了一個安穩的夜晚。

scripts.text: Listen to the request.
scripts.translation: 聽取請求

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Milla]
You can't do this if you're busy...
Ah, after all, the living do not hear that sound. This is my agony only known to the dead...
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
如果你忙的話，可能做不到吧...
啊，畢竟活人是聽不到那種聲音的。這是我只有亡者才能體會的痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Milla]
Beloved living, thank you for your mercy.
It's a luxurious facility with a banquet hall and an Opera House, but each one is a little different.
I'll ask for that kind of skill based on your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
親愛的生者，感謝你的慈悲。
那裡有豪華的宴會廳和歌劇院，但每一處都略有不同。
我會根據你的善意，請求相應的技能...

scripts.text: He looks cute
scripts.translation: 看起來很可愛

scripts.text: That's not an instrument
scripts.translation: 那不是樂器

scripts.text: Playing the piano
scripts.translation: 彈鋼琴

scripts.text: Guys with messy hair
scripts.translation: 頭髮亂糟糟的傢伙

scripts.text: The ones with dolls
scripts.translation: 拿著玩偶的傢伙

scripts.text: Wake them up
scripts.translation: 把他們叫醒

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Milla]
I think they've had enough today.
I hope you can help me tomorrow if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
我想他們今天已經夠累了。
如果你有時間，希望明天也能幫我。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
They look cute... but they're terribly noisy.
^0000FF{0}^000000,
^0000FF{1}^000000

[Milla]
I wish you could beat 15 {0}
and 15 of their mate {1}, who haunted the banquet hall of the dead,
and make them holy for a day.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
希望你能擊敗15只{0}
和15只它們的同類{1}，
它們正在騷擾亡者宴會廳，
讓它們安靜一天。

scripts.text: I accept
scripts.translation: 我接受

scripts.text: I'm busy today
scripts.translation: 我今天很忙

scripts.text:
[Milla]
Ummm...
Yeah... Well, I won't die just because I can't sleep...
I'm already dead
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
嗯...
是啊...反正睡不著也不會死...
我已經死了。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
Thank you for your kind heart.
Blessed be the mercy of the living!
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
感謝你的宅心仁厚。
願生者的慈悲保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Milla]
I wish you could beat 15 {0}
and 15 of their mate {1}, who haunted the banquet hall of the dead,
and make them holy for a day.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
希望你能擊敗15只{0}
和15只它們的同類{1}，
它們正在騷擾亡者宴會廳，
讓它們安靜一天。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
Kya, did you hear them scream all the way here?
I think I can sleep a little deeper today thanks to you...
I have to make it through this commotion again tomorrow.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
啊，你聽到它們一路尖叫到這裡了嗎？
多虧了你，我想今天能睡得更沉一點...
明天還得再經歷一次這場喧鬧。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
I think they've had enough today.
I hope you can help me tomorrow if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
我想他們今天已經夠累了。
如果你有時間，希望明天也能幫我。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
It's called ^0000FF{0}^000000.
They have knives in their hands... 
It's too loud to knock anywhere!
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
它們叫^0000FF{0}^000000。
它們手裡拿著刀...
敲得哪裡都太吵了！

scripts.text:
[Milla]
I wish you could beat 10 {0}
and 10 of their mate {1}, who haunted the banquet hall of the dead,
and make them holy for a day.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
希望你能擊敗10只{0}
和10只它們的同類{1}，
它們正在騷擾亡者宴會廳，
讓它們安靜一天。

scripts.text: I accept
scripts.translation: 我接受

scripts.text: I'm busy today
scripts.translation: 我今天很忙

scripts.text:
[Milla]
Ummm...
Yeah... Well, I won't die just because I can't sleep...
I'm already dead.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
嗯...
是啊...反正睡不著也不會死...
我已經死了。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
Thank you for your kind heart.
Blessed be the mercy of the living!
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
感謝你的宅心仁厚。
願生者的慈悲保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Milla]
I wish you could beat 10 {0}
and 10 of their mate {1}, who haunted the banquet hall of the dead,
and make them holy for a day.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
希望你能擊敗10只{0}
和10只它們的同類{1}，
它們正在騷擾亡者宴會廳，
讓它們安靜一天。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
Kya, did you hear the sound of their cleavers and their helmets flying all the way up to here?
I think I can sleep a little deeper today thanks to you...
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
啊，你聽到它們的克利弗和頭盔一路飛到這裡的聲音了嗎？
多虧了你，我想今天能睡得更沉一點...
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
I think they've had enough today.
I hope you can help me tomorrow if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
我想他們今天已經夠累了。
如果你有時間，希望明天也能幫我。

scripts.text:
[Milla]
If you go into the banquet hall of the dead there, there will be a piano.
It actually screams when a living person knocks on it.
Would it be fun?
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
如果你走進那邊的亡者宴會廳，那裡有一架鋼琴。
活人敲它的時候，它其實會尖叫。
是不是很搞笑？

scripts.text:
[Milla]
Play the <NAVI>[piano]<INFO>nif_dun01,140,202,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>
of the banquet hall of the dead.
There is no such thing as a song request.
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
它似乎沒有進行非常非法的實驗，而是專注於研究將凱美拉培育成生命體，但據說在一次地下魔法發電廠爆炸後被廢棄了。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
It came under investigation because one of the administrators of that abandoned lab was Werner.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
之所以被調查，是因為那個廢棄實驗室的管理員之一是Werner。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
As a result of the investigation, the chimeras that were being cultivated ran out of control due to an explosion accident and turned into monsters and were left unattended.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
調查結果發現，正在培育的凱美拉因爆炸事故失控，變成了魔物，且無人看管。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
I couldn't tell if it was just neglected or intentionally.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
我無法確定那是疏忽大意還是故意的。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
It's not far from the city, so Rebellion took care of organizing it for safety reasons... As you've heard, we're having trouble with the lack of staff.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
它離城市不遠，所以反叛者出於安全原因負責清理工作... 如您所知，我們人手不足，遇到了困難。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
With your help, we can make the cleanup easier!
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
有您的幫助，清理工作會更容易！

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Okay. Could you help me with the subjugation?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
好的。您能幫助我們鎮壓它們嗎？

scripts.text: Help
scripts.translation: 幫助

scripts.text: Don't help
scripts.translation: 不協助

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Ah... Excuse me.
It's our job and we're just looking for help.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
啊... 抱歉。
這是我們的工作，我們只是在尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
You must have your own things to do!
We will try to solve this by ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
您肯定有自己的事情要做！
我們會嘗試自己解決這個問題。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
It is an honor to work with you!
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
能與您一起工作是我的榮幸！

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Thank you for your cooperation!
Let's organize the group again...
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
感謝您的合作！
讓我們重新組織一下團隊...

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Are you comfortable taking the mission alone or with the Rebellion's mission team?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
您更傾向於獨自執行任務，還是與反叛者的任務團隊一起？

scripts.text: I'm comfortable alone
scripts.translation: 我獨自行動沒問題

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
If so, let's combine the Rebellion mission groups into one, and the hero's solo mission... mumble mumble.
Oh, why am I the only one thinking. Gerbena, help me!
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
如果是這樣，讓我們把反叛者的任務組合併成一個，英雄的單人任務... 咕咕咕。
哦，為什麼只有我在想。格爾貝娜，幫幫我！

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Oops, yes!
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
哎呀，是的！

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Hero, these are the things we would like to ask of you from Amicitia.
Which of these would you like to help with?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
英雄，這些是我們希望從Amicitia那裡請求您的事項。
您想幫助哪一項？

scripts.text: Earth and Fire
scripts.translation: 土與火

scripts.text: Water and Wind
scripts.translation: 水與風

scripts.text: Traces of Werner
scripts.translation: 維爾納的痕跡

scripts.text: Don't help
scripts.translation: 不協助

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Now, the Rebellion unit is in the process of following up.
It's okay, hero, to rest a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
現在，反叛者部隊正在跟進處理。
英雄，您可以再休息一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Thank you for being so active with us.
Can you come back after dawn?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
感謝您一直以來的積極協助。
您能在黎明之後回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
I would like to ask you to hunt <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> among the chimeras in culture.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
我想請您在培養中的凱美拉中，獵殺<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0}和{1}</FONT>。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
You will be able to recognize them right away as the attribute characteristics of earth and fire appear much stronger than those of existing entities.
Actually, it's more like a monster than a homunculus...
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
由於土屬性和火屬性的特徵比現有的生命體更為強烈，您應該能一眼認出它們。
實際上，它們更像魔物而非生命體...

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Despite the destruction of the culture facility, the number of individuals continues to increase, so I would like to ask you to hunt about 15 specimens of each!
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
儘管培養設施已被破壞，但個體數量仍在增加，所以我想請您每種獵殺約15只！

scripts.text: Hunt
scripts.translation: 獵殺

scripts.text: Do not hunt
scripts.translation: 不獵殺

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Hmm? Have you changed your mind?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
嗯？您改變主意了？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Well, then! We have to re-organize! Ugh.
Hero, why don't you reconsider calmly?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
好吧！我們得重新整理一下！唉。
英雄，您不妨冷靜地再考慮一下？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Thank you very much for your support. The two types of chimeras will probably be roaming the ground floor of the closed lab Amicitia.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
非常感謝您的支援。這兩種凱美拉可能會在封閉的實驗室Amicitia的一樓遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Please don't let the chimeras leave the lab.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
請別讓凱美拉離開實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> will be roaming the first floor of the closed lab Amicitia.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0}和{1}</FONT>將在封閉的實驗室Amicitia的一樓遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Please hunt 15 of each.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
請每種獵殺15只。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Have you been there? You have completed all the tasks I mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
您去過那裡嗎？您已完成我提到的所有任務。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Rebellion units are also on duty.
Thanks to the hero who organized it one step ahead, it seems to have made it easier to enter.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
反叛者部隊也在執勤。
多虧了提前一步整理好一切的英雄，進入似乎變得更容易了。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
As expected from a hero. It is rare to find someone outside of the Rebellions who works with such sincerity and cleanliness.
I would be grateful if you could join the mission tomorrow as well.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
不愧是英雄。在反叛者之外，很少有人能如此真誠且乾淨利落地工作。
如果您明天也能參加任務，我將不勝感激。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Now, the Rebellion unit is in the process of following up.
It's okay, hero, to rest a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
現在，反叛者部隊正在跟進處理。
英雄，您可以再休息一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Thank you for being so active with us.
Can you come back after dawn?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
感謝您一直以來的積極協助。
您能在黎明之後回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
I would like to ask you to hunt <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> among the chimeras that were being cultured.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
我想請您在正在培養的凱美拉中，獵殺<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0}和{1}</FONT>。

scripts.text: It's not difficult to tell them apart because they've mutated into an appearance that clearly reveals the attributes of wind and water.
scripts.translation: 它們變異成了明顯顯現風屬性和水屬性特徵的外觀，因此很容易區分。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
The number of individuals continues to increase without the help of a culture facility, so please hunt 15 of each.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
即使沒有培養設施，它們個體的數量也在不斷增加，所以請各獵殺15只。

scripts.text: Hunt
scripts.translation: 獵殺

scripts.text: Do not hunt
scripts.translation: 不獵殺

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Hmm? Have you changed your mind?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
嗯？您改變主意了？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Well, then! we have to re-organize! Ugh.
Hero, why don't you reconsider calmly?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
好了，那麼！我們必須重新整理一下！唉。
英雄，您不妨冷靜地再考慮一下？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Thank you very much for your support. The two types of chimeras are staying on the first floor of the closed lab Amicitia.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
非常感謝您的支援。這兩種凱美拉正待在封閉實驗室阿米西提亞的一樓。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Please don't let the chimeras leave the lab.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
請別讓凱美拉離開實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> are staying on the first floor of the closed lab Amicitia.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0}和{1}</FONT>正待在封閉實驗室阿米西提亞的一樓。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Please hunt 15 of each.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
請每種獵殺15只。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Mission completed, confirmed.
Now deploy the rebellion troops.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
任務完成，已確認。
現在部署反叛者部隊。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Thanks to the hero who organized it one step ahead, we will be able to enter easily..
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
多虧了提前一步整理好一切的您，我們將能輕鬆進入。
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Working with someone outside of Rebellion, this is the first time I've felt such a good fit.
Hero, would you like to join the mission tomorrow as well?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
與反叛者之外的人合作，這是我第一次感到如此契合。
英雄，您明天也願意參加任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Now, the Rebellion unit is in the process of following up.
It's okay, hero, to rest a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
現在，反叛者部隊正在跟進處理。
英雄，您可以再休息一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Thank you for being so active with us.
Can you come back after dawn?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
感謝您一直以來的積極協助。
您能在黎明之後回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
This is a high-security job, so I only want to ask the hero a favor.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
這是一項高保密任務，所以我只想拜託英雄您一件事。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
I didn't want to go through the mouths of as many people as possible, so the Rebellion units were excluded from this job.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
我不想讓儘可能多的人知道，所以反叛者部隊被排除在這次任務之外。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Nothing else, but to find <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Traces of Werner</FONT> on the 1st floor of the abandoned lab Amicitia.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
沒有其他要求，只需在廢棄實驗室阿米西提亞的一樓尋找<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>維爾納的痕跡</FONT>。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
What part of Amicitia was managed by Werner, what kind of experiments he conducted, etc...
If anything has had an impact on the Institute, please come to me.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
維爾納負責管理阿米西提亞的哪個部分，他進行了什麼樣的實驗，等等...
如果有任何對研究所造成影響的東西，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Documents, files, data! Anything is fine.
Would you like to go for me?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
檔案、檔案、資料！什麼都行。
您願意替我去一趟嗎？

scripts.text: I will go
scripts.translation: 我會去

scripts.text: I will not go
scripts.translation: 我不會去

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
That's alright. But it's also annoying...
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
沒關係。但這也很令人煩惱...

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
I would appreciate it if you could keep this request a secret.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
如果您能保守這個請求的秘密，我將不勝感激。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Okay. It won't be easy to find... Any traces, so please come back to me with just one.
Then, I would like to thank you.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
好的。尋找痕跡並不容易...只要找到任何痕跡，請帶著一份回來給我。
那樣，我將非常感謝您。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
It won't be easy to find... Any traces, so please come back to me with just one.
Then, I would like to thank you.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
尋找痕跡並不容易...只要找到任何痕跡，請帶著一份回來給我。
那樣，我將非常感謝您。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Did you find any traces?
You've come to the right place. This note is in Werner's handwriting.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
您找到痕跡了嗎？
您來對地方了。這張紙條是維爾納的筆跡。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Thank you. We will hand this over to the secret wing agents for investigation.
Then you should be rewarded for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
謝謝。我們會將此交給秘密部門特工進行調查。
那麼您應該會因為您的辛勤工作而獲得獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Thank you for coming back tomorrow and working with me.
Because I can't just leave this to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
感謝您明天回來協助我。
因為這件事，我不能隨便交給任何人。

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Hmm? Have you changed your mind?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
嗯？您改變主意了？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
Well, then! We have to re-organize! Ugh.
Hero, why don't you reconsider calmly?
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
好吧！我們得重新整理一下！唉。
英雄，您不妨冷靜地再考慮一下？

scripts.text:
[Something]
There is something on the floor. Shall we take a closer look?
scripts.translation:
[某物]
地上有東西。我們要不要湊近看看？

scripts.text:
[Something]
Research memo in neat handwriting. Werner's handwriting is exactly like this.
scripts.translation:
[某物]
這是一份字跡工整的研究備忘錄。維爾納的字跡正是這樣的。

scripts.text:
[Something]
Let's take it and check it out.
scripts.translation:
[某物]
我們把它拿起來檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Something]
Something is off the floor.
It looks like it's just garbage.
scripts.translation:
[某物]
地上有東西。
看起來只是垃圾。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Wow, {0}! Can I get an autograph?
It's an honor! Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
哇，{0}！能給我籤個名嗎？
真是榮幸！嘿嘿~

scripts.text: - This is a quest that can be performed at level 230 or higher -
scripts.translation: - 此任務需要等級230或以上才能進行 -

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Hero, there was a homunculus intensive culture room on the second floor of the Amicitia lab.
They were creating more powerful mutated chimeras.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
英雄，阿米西亞實驗室的二樓有一個生命體強化培養室。
他們正在製造更強大的變異凱美拉。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
It's pitiful, but if they are released from the lab, they will do more damage than you can imagine.
Can you help me clean up these chimeras?
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
雖然很可憐，但如果它們從實驗室逃脫，造成的破壞將超出您的想像。
您能幫我清理這些凱美拉嗎？

scripts.text: Imitation and Real
scripts.translation: 模仿與真實

scripts.text: Natural change
scripts.translation: 自然變異

scripts.text: Don't help
scripts.translation: 不協助

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Have you already been there today? If so, how about taking a break?
If you overwork your body, you may not do well.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
您今天已經去過那裡了嗎？如果是的話，不如休息一下？
如果過度勞累，身體可能會吃不消。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Come back after dawn and work with us!
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
請在黎明之後回來，與我們一起工作！

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Some of the work they were doing in the incubator was mass production of mutated chimeras.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
他們在孵化器中進行的一些工作，是批次生產變異凱美拉。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
They re-mutated the mutated homunculus and further strengthened their aggression.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
他們對變異的生命體進行了再次變異，並進一步增強了它們的攻擊性。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Please hunt 15 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> each.
Both are creatures that imitate human form, but add a powerful transformation of the chimera properties to it.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
請各獵殺15只 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} 和 {1}</FONT>。
它們都是模仿人類形態的生物，但在此基礎上增加了強大的凱美拉特性變異。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
It's been quite some time since the lab was closed and left unattended.
A quick hunt would make me feel more comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
實驗室關閉並無人看管已經有一段時間了。
快速清理一下，我會更安心。

scripts.text: Help hunting
scripts.translation: 協助狩獵

scripts.text: Do not hunt
scripts.translation: 不獵殺

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Ah, you changed your words!
Gerbena is heartbroken!
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
啊，您改變主意了！
格爾貝娜心都碎了！

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
But it was our one-sided request.
Even if you refuse, we can't help it...
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
但畢竟是我們單方面的請求。
即使您拒絕，我們也無可奈何...

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
It's an honor that you help us!
Can I participate with you hero?
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
您願意幫助我們，真是榮幸！
英雄，我可以和您一起行動嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
He doesn't like it. He is more comfortable doing it alone, calm down, Gerbena.
scripts.translation:
[安蘇莉雅]
他不喜歡那樣。他更喜歡獨自行動，冷靜點，格爾貝娜。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Ugh! Please take care of it for me!!
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
嗚！拜託您一定要幫我啊！！

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Please hunt 15 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> each.
Both are creatures that imitate human form, but add a powerful transformation of the chimera properties to it.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
請各獵殺15只 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} 和 {1}</FONT>。
它們都是模仿人類形態的生物，但在此基礎上增加了強大的凱美拉特性變異。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Now the Illusion Forces are deployed and continue their mission.
Thanks to the hero, it's easy to enter and subdue the Chimera.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
現在<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺部隊已經部署，並繼續執行任務。
多虧了英雄，進入並制服凱美拉變得很容易。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Ugh, I also wanted to see the hero's wonderful battle in person...
Maybe someday I'll have a chance to see you?
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
嗚，我也好想親眼看看英雄精彩的戰鬥啊...
也許有一天我會有機會見到您？

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
If it's okay with you, why don't you come back tomorrow and work with us?
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
如果您不介意的話，明天回來和我們一起工作吧？

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Have you already been there today? If so, how about taking a break?
If you overwork your body, you may not do well.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
您今天已經去過那裡了嗎？如果是的話，不如休息一下？
如果過度勞累，身體可能會吃不消。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Come back after dawn and work with us!
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
請在黎明之後回來，與我們一起工作！

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Among the homunculus in the intensive culture chamber, there are Mutant Chimera Lavaeter and Mutant Chimera Fulgor.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
在強化培養室中的生命體裡，有變異凱美拉·拉瓦埃特和變異凱美拉·富爾戈爾。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
It looks similar to the existing Homunculus Dieter and Homunculus Bayeri, but they are very different.
It is different from a homunculus in that it reproduces itself and it decides without an owner.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
它們看起來和現有的生命體·迪特以及生命體·拜爾裡很像，但完全不同。
它們會自行繁殖，並且在沒有主人的情況下自行決定行動，這與普通生命體不同。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
You can't rescue them or do anything. All, every single one of them has to be killed.
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
您無法拯救它們或做任何其他事。所有，每一個都必須被殺死。

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
So, hero, would you like to help us hunt 15 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> each?
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
那麼，英雄，您願意幫我們獵殺15只 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} 和 {1}</FONT> 嗎？

scripts.text: Help hunting
scripts.translation: 協助狩獵

scripts.text: Do not hunt
scripts.translation: 不獵殺

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
Ah, you changed your words!
Gerbena is heartbroken!
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
啊，您改變主意了！
格爾貝娜心都碎了！

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
But it was our one-sided request.
Even if you refuse, we can't help it...
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
但畢竟是我們單方面的請求。
即使您拒絕，我們也無可奈何...

scripts.text:
[Gerbena]
It's an honor that you help us!
Can I participate with you hero?
scripts.translation:
[格爾貝娜]
您願意幫助我們，真是榮幸！
英雄，我可以和您一起行動嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ansuriya]
He said he doesn't like it. He is more comfortable doing it alone, calm down, Gerbena.
scripts.translation:

他說他不喜歡那樣。他更喜歡獨自行動，冷靜點，格爾貝娜。

scripts.text:

Ugh! Please take care of it for me!!
scripts.translation:
